caption: The drawing features a composition of various flowers and leaves arranged in a curving, decorative pattern. There are three prominent flowers: two with pink petals and green calyxes near the top and center, and one with darker pink petals and a yellow center near the bottom. Numerous small blue flowers with yellow centers are scattered throughout, attached to thin brown stems. The arrangement includes multiple green leaves of varying shapes and sizes, some with serrated edges and others more rounded, all connected by brown, winding stems that interweave to form an overall looping shape. Small yellow buds also appear on a few stems, and the entire composition is set against a plain, light beige background.
title: Embroidery
